supersedes: phase1_chapman_seed1_v3 for pre-outcome duplicate-export handling only
research_question: Do conventional random lead-dropout evaluations predict the diagnostic robustness of 12-lead ECG classifiers under a preregistered library of physically realizable acquisition faults?

source.confirmation: Ningbo sealed; no waveform access or inference

duplicate_resolution.cluster_definition: SHA-256 of the unmodified waveform matrix/file, with exact matrix equality required
duplicate_resolution.noncanonical_rule: mark as duplicate export; retain all source files

endpoint_amendment.rule: No endpoint/fault/architecture/threshold alteration after outcomes are inspected.

split.algorithm: Within each 3-bit label stratum, sort SHA256(str(seed)+canonical_record_id); allocate deterministic 70/10/20 contiguous sections. Hash sorted membership before training. Require zero record-ID and waveform-hash overlap.

preprocessing.normalization: per-display-lead mean/std from canonical Chapman train only
preprocessing.unavailable_sentinel: train-normalized zero for inference only; not a physical open-circuit waveform

model.name: ECGResNet-small
model.loss: weighted multilabel BCE, positive weights capped at 20
model.augmentation: none designed to repair physical faults

baseline_gate.failure: STOP_BASELINE_INADEQUATE; do not access internal test

failure_analysis.primary_estimand: T-wave AUPRC degradation under V1-V4 unavailable minus mean degradation under other 69 four-of-eight independent subsets
failure_analysis.random_rule: compute each subset metric separately inside every bootstrap replicate; never average prediction vectors
failure_analysis.display_masks_secondary_only: all C(12,4)=495 conventional displayed-lead zero masks

proceed: at least one preregistered physical scenario T-wave AUPRC loss >=0.05
not explained by equal-or-larger degradation of both rate negative controls
